title: Missing meeting invites
symptom: User never receives meeting invitations from a colleague
user_description: My manager says she's sent me three meeting invites but I haven't received any. I'm missing meetings!

options.text: Create a new Outlook profile immediately
options.why: A big step before any checks. Other mail arrives normally, so the profile is not the likely cause.

options.text: Ask the organiser to phone everyone instead
options.why: Avoids the problem instead of fixing it, and the invites will keep going missing.

options.text: Check Junk Email and other folders and any inbox rules, confirm the organiser used the right address, and check the calendar's meeting request settings
options.why: Invites can be caught by the junk filter or a rule, or sent to a wrong or old address. Checking all three places finds most missing invites.
Drastic and unlikely. Other emails arrive, so the program is working.

hints: Where could an invite end up other than the Inbox?
Could a rule be moving it somewhere?
Is the organiser sending to the right address?
real_world_tip: Ask the organiser for a sent copy of one invite. It shows the exact address it was sent to.
